use tree_subset::{
    Edition, LexedStr, SyntaxElement, SyntaxTree, TextRange, TokenOrigin, build_tree,
    parse_expansion_with_edition, parse_source_text_with_edition,
    parser::{self, Fragment, Input},
};
mod corpus;

fn mix(hash: &mut u64, value: u64) {
    *hash = hash.rotate_left(9) ^ value;
    *hash = hash.wrapping_mul(0x9e3779b185ebca87);
}

fn bytes(hash: &mut u64, value: &str) {
    mix(hash, value.len() as u64);
    for byte in value.bytes() {
        mix(hash, byte as u64);
    }
}

fn inspect(hash: &mut u64, tree: &SyntaxTree, text: &str) {
    tree.validate().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(tree.text(), text);
    assert_eq!(tree.root().text(), text);
    assert_eq!(tree.root().parent(), None);
    assert_eq!(tree.root().descendants().len(), tree.node_count());
    assert_eq!(tree.root().tokens().len(), tree.token_count());
    bytes(hash, &format!("{:#?}", tree));
    let mut restored = String::new();
    for token in tree.root().tokens() {
        assert_eq!(token.text(), &text[token.raw_range()]);
        assert_eq!(token.tree().text(), text);
        restored.push_str(token.text());
        bytes(
            hash,
            &format!(
                "{} {:?} {:?} {} {:?}",
                token.index(),
                token.kind(),
                token.text_range(),
                token.ctxt(),
                tree.token_origin(token.index())
            ),
        );
    }
    assert_eq!(restored, text);
    for node in tree.root().descendants() {
        assert_eq!(tree.node(node.id()), node);
        assert_eq!(node.text(), &text[node.raw_range()]);
        assert_eq!(node.first_child(), node.children().next());
        let mut tiled = String::new();
        for element in node.children_with_tokens() {
            mix(hash, element.kind() as u64);
            bytes(
                hash,
                &format!("{:?} {:?}", element.raw_range(), element.text_range()),
            );
            match element {
                SyntaxElement::Node(child) => {
                    assert_eq!(child.parent(), Some(node));
                    assert_eq!(element.into_node(), Some(child));
                    assert!(element.into_token().is_none());
                    tiled.push_str(child.text());
                }
                SyntaxElement::Token(token) => {
                    assert_eq!(element.into_token(), Some(token));
                    assert!(element.into_node().is_none());
                    tiled.push_str(token.text());
                }
            }
        }
        assert_eq!(tiled, node.text());
        bytes(
            hash,
            &format!(
                "{:?} {:?} {} {:?}",
                node.id(),
                node.raw_range(),
                node.ctxt(),
                node.parent().map(|parent| parent.id())
            ),
        );
    }
}

fn source(hash: &mut u64, text: &str, edition: Edition, trace: bool) -> usize {
    let parsed = parse_source_text_with_edition(text.into(), edition);
    // Both public build_tree and the owned-text build entry point must agree.
    let lexed = LexedStr::with_edition(text, edition);
    let input = Input::from_lexed(&lexed);
    let (tree, errors) = build_tree(lexed, parser::parse_source_file(&input));
    assert_eq!(&tree, parsed.tree());
    assert_eq!(errors, parsed.errors());
    inspect(hash, &tree, text);
    let dump = parsed.debug_dump();
    bytes(hash, &dump);
    if trace {
        print!("{}", dump);
    }
    for error in parsed.errors() {
        assert!(error.range.end() as usize <= text.len());
        assert!(text.is_char_boundary(error.range.start() as usize));
    }
    parsed.errors().len()
}

fn main() {
    let mut hash = 0;
    let mut prefixes = 0;
    for &(name, text, expect_errors) in corpus::FILES {
        for edition in [Edition::E2021, Edition::E2024] {
            let errors = source(&mut hash, text, edition, true);
            assert_eq!(errors > 0, expect_errors);
            for (end, _) in text.char_indices() {
                source(&mut hash, &text[..end], edition, false);
                prefixes += 1;
            }
        }
        println!("file={} hash={}", name, hash);
    }
    for &(name, text) in corpus::WORKSPACE {
        source(&mut hash, text, Edition::E2024, true);
        println!("workspace={} hash={}", name, hash);
    }
    // Exact attachment expectations independent of the reference executable.
    for (text, expected) in [
        ("// attached\nfn f() {}\n", "// attached\nfn f() {}"),
        ("// detached\n\nfn f() {}\n", "fn f() {}"),
        ("//! inner\nfn f() {}\n", "fn f() {}"),
        ("/* attached */\nfn f() {}", "/* attached */\nfn f() {}"),
        ("// detached\n\r\nfn f() {}", "fn f() {}"),
    ] {
        let parsed = parse_source_text_with_edition(text.into(), Edition::E2024);
        assert_eq!(parsed.root().first_child().unwrap().text(), expected);
        source(&mut hash, text, Edition::E2024, true);
    }
    // Build expansions from raw lexer-token origins: composite punctuation must
    // merge their spans. Exercise mixed groups, reversed spans, missing origins,
    // hygiene, trivia and mapping errors at EOF as well as on tokens.
    for (fragment, text) in [
        (Fragment::Expr, "a::b::<T>() >> 2"),
        (Fragment::Expr, "a + /* gap */ b"),
        (Fragment::Expr, "a +"),
        (Fragment::Items, "// doc\nfn f() {} struct S;"),
        (Fragment::Stmts, "let x = 1; x + 2"),
        (Fragment::Type, "Vec<Vec<u8>>"),
        (Fragment::Expr, "  "),
    ] {
        for scenario in 0..5 {
            let lexed = LexedStr::new(text);
            let mut origins = Vec::new();
            for i in 0..lexed.len() {
                if lexed.kind(i).is_trivia() || (scenario == 3 && i % 2 == 0) {
                    continue;
                }
                let range = lexed.token_range(i);
                let start = if scenario == 2 {
                    1000 - range.end()
                } else {
                    100 + range.start()
                };
                let group = if scenario == 1 { i as u32 % 2 } else { 0 };
                origins.push((
                    range.start(),
                    TokenOrigin {
                        range: TextRange::new(start, start + range.len()),
                        group,
                        ctxt: 7 + i as u32,
                    },
                ));
            }
            if scenario == 4 {
                origins.clear();
            }
            let call_site = TextRange::new(2000, 2010);
            let parsed = parse_expansion_with_edition(
                text.into(),
                &origins,
                call_site,
                fragment,
                Edition::E2024,
            );
            assert!(parsed.tree().is_expansion());
            inspect(&mut hash, parsed.tree(), text);
            print!(
                "expansion={:?}/{} {}",
                fragment,
                scenario,
                parsed.debug_dump()
            );
            for end in 0..=text.len() {
                let mapped = parsed.tree().map_text_range(TextRange::empty(end as u32));
                bytes(&mut hash, &format!("{:?}", mapped));
            }
            if scenario == 4 && parsed.tree().root().tokens().any(|t| !t.kind().is_trivia()) {
                assert_eq!(parsed.root().text_range(), call_site);
            }
        }
    }
    assert!(prefixes > 0);
    println!("prefixes={} hash={}", prefixes, hash);
}
